title: Goldreich–Levin call confidence
statement: For a natural number $n$ and threshold $\tau\in(0,1]$, the call confidence parameter is $1/[40(n+1)(A(\tau)+1)]$, where $A(\tau)$ is the active cap at threshold $\tau$.
